start: Owner on the Visits page of a gym with at least one pass member (FITPASS, cultpass or another pass)

start: Owner on the Visits page of a gym with no pass member and no past pass visit

steps.action: Look at the top of the page
user_sees: Only "Check-in QR"; no "Pass visits" button
must_not: A "Pass visits" button that leads to an empty page

steps.action: Type the address /attendance/pass by hand
user_sees: The Pass visits page opens (the address has no check of its own); what it shows for a gym with no pass member: unknown
must_not: An error page or a blank screen

start: Owner on the Visits page; the gym's only pass member is archived after some pass visits

steps.action: Open Visits before the gym has any pass member
user_sees: No "Pass visits" button

steps.action: Turn on "Comes with a pass" for a member (Members page), check them in, open Visits
user_sees: The "Pass visits" button appears
must_not: The button appears only after signing out and in

steps.action: Archive that member, open Visits again
user_sees: The "Pass visits" button stays, because a past pass visit exists
must_not: Past pass visits vanish from the month count when the member is archived
